description.zh:
数仓版集群ID。
>您可以调用[DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~)接口查看目标地域下所有数仓版集群的集群ID。
description.en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster.

> You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) clusters within a region.

description.zh:
弹性计划是否生效，取值说明：

- **true**（默认值）：生效。
- **false**：不生效。
description.en:
Specifies whether the scaling plan takes effect. Valid values:

*   **true** (default)
*   **false**

description.zh: 弹性计划结束日期，格式：yyyy-MM-dd。
description.en: The end date of the scaling plan. Specify the date in the yyyy-MM-dd format.

description.zh: 执行弹性计划的周期。数字表示每个月的几号，多个日期用半角逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The dates of the month when you want to execute the scaling plan. A number specifies a date of the month. Separate multiple values with commas (,).

description.zh:
弹性计划名称，取值说明：

- 长度为2~30字符。
- 由大写字母、小写字母、数字或下划线（_）组成。
>您可以调用[DescribeElasticPlan](~~190596~~)接口查看指定集群下所有弹性计划的详细信息，包括弹性计划名称。
description.en:
The name of the scaling plan.

*   The name must be 2 to 30 characters in length.
*   The name can contain letters, digits, and underscores (\_).

> You can call the [DescribeElasticPlan](~~190596~~) operation to query the information about all scaling plans of a cluster, including the scaling plan names.

description.zh:
弹性计划节点数。

- 当ElasticPlanType为**worker**时，该参数可以不填写或者填写0。

- 当ElasticPlanType为**executorcombineworker**或**executor**时，该参数必须填写大于0的数字。
description.en:
The number of nodes that are involved in the scaling plan.

*   If ElasticPlanType is set to **worker**, you can set this parameter to 0 or leave this parameter empty.
*   If ElasticPlanType is set to **executorcombineworker** or **executor**, you must set this parameter to a value that is greater than 0.

description.zh: 弹性计划起始日期，格式：yyyy-MM-dd。
description.en: The start date of the scaling plan. Specify the date in the yyyy-MM-dd format.

description.zh: 弹性计划还原时间，只支持设置整点时间，与弹性计划扩容时间的间隔不能超过24小时。格式：HH:mm:ss。
description.en: The restoration time of the scaling plan. Specify the time on the hour in the HH:mm:ss format. The interval between the scale-up time and the restoration time cannot be more than 24 hours.

description.zh: 弹性计划扩容时间，只支持设置整点时间。格式：HH:mm:ss。
description.en: The scale-up time of the scaling plan. Specify the time on the hour in the HH:mm:ss format.

description.zh:
弹性计划资源类型，取值说明：

- **worker**：弹性IO资源单独弹性。
- **executor**：计算资源单独弹性。
- **executorcombineworker**（默认值）：计算，弹性IO资源按默认比例弹性。

> - 如果要使用**executorcombineworker**，集群内核版本需为3.1.3.2及以上版本。
> - 如果要使用**worker**或**executor**，集群内核版本需为3.1.6.1及以上版本，且需要通过提交工单申请。申请通过后，才能使用**worker**或**executor**。
description.en:
The type of the scaling plan. Valid values:

*   **worker**: scales only elastic I/O resources.
*   **executor**: scales only computing resources.
*   **executorcombineworker** (default): scales both elastic I/O resources and computing resources by proportion.

> 

*   If you want to set this parameter to **executorcombineworker**, make sure that the cluster runs a minor version of 3.1.3.2 or later.

*   If you want to set this parameter to **worker** or **executor**, make sure that the cluster runs a minor version of 3.1.6.1 or later and a ticket is submitted. After your request is approved, you can set this parameter to **worker** or **executor**.

description.zh: 执行弹性计划的周期。0~6表示周日到周六，多个日期用半角逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The days of the week when you want to execute the scaling plan. Valid values: 0 to 6, which indicate Sunday to Saturday. Separate multiple values with commas (,).

description.zh:
弹性计划支持扩容的资源规格，取值说明：

- 8 Core 64 GB（默认规格）

- 16 Core 64 GB

- 32 Core 64 GB

- 64 Core 128 GB

- 12 Core 96 GB

- 24 Core 96 GB

- 52 Core 86 GB
description.en:
The resource specifications that can be scaled up by the scaling plan. Valid values:

*   8 Core 64 GB (default)
*   16 Core 64 GB
*   32 Core 64 GB
*   64 Core 128 GB
*   12 Core 96 GB
*   24 Core 96 GB
*   52 Core 86 GB

description.zh:
资源组名称。
>您可以调用[DescribeDBResourceGroup](~~466685~~)接口查看资源组名称。
description.en:
The name of the resource group.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBResourceGroup](~~466685~~) operation to query the resource group name.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun adb modify-elastic-plan --db-cluster-id am-bp1rqvm70uh2v0000 --elastic-plan-name realtime --resource-pool-name test --elastic-plan-node-num 0 --elastic-plan-time-start 8:00:00 --elastic-plan-time-end 10:00:00 --elastic-plan-weekly-repeat 1,2,3,4,5 --elastic-plan-monthly-repeat 1,15,25 --elastic-plan-start-day 2022-12-02 --elastic-plan-end-day 2022-12-09 --elastic-plan-enable true --elastic-plan-type worker --elastic-plan-worker-spec 16_Core_64_GB --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun adb ModifyElasticPlan --region cn-hangzhou --ElasticPlanType worker --ElasticPlanNodeNum 0 --ElasticPlanWeeklyRepeat '1,2,3,4,5' --ElasticPlanStartDay '2022-12-02' --ElasticPlanWorkerSpec 16_Core_64_GB --DBClusterId 'am-bp1rqvm70uh2v0000' --ResourcePoolName test --ElasticPlanEnable true --ElasticPlanEndDay '2022-12-09' --ElasticPlanTimeStart '8:00:00' --ElasticPlanTimeEnd '10:00:00' --ElasticPlanName realtime --ElasticPlanMonthlyRepeat '1,15,25'
